payment_contract_id.description: This parameter can be found in the portal on the Payment Provider Contract attached to your organization or given to you by a Verifone employee. It is used to retrieve MID and other merchant configurations necessary for a card payment.

authorization_type.description: Card Authorization Type (PRE_AUTH, FINAL_AUTH).  When capture now is set to true pre-authorization transactions cannot be done.

capture_now.description:
True - transaction will be sent as authCapture and automatically captured.
False - transaction will be sent as auth and only authorized. NOT CAPTURED.
If you don't have any value in the capture_now parameter, at the moment of the call the value will be set as TRUE.
